summary: The minor is FEMGEN 101 and a theory course (FEMGEN 103 or another listed one), each for at least 4 units and a letter grade, and 16 units from any of the FGSS course lists, for at least six courses and 25 units. Courses outside the lists, from other departments or from other schools, count with the Faculty Director's approval and are moved in by hand, and your advisor checks that none of these units also counts toward your major or another minor.

totals.label: At least six courses
totals.why: Policies: "The minor in Feminist, Gender, and Sexuality Studies consists of at least six courses for a minimum of 25 units."
